description: Re-read the configuration file and apply provider, rate-limit, and knowledge-base changes without restarting; active connections are preserved. Use when you have edited config.json or config.local.json, or when passing `patch` to change configuration programmatically. Do NOT use to inspect configuration or provider state (use infobroker_inspect_providers). `patch` merges a partial config into the user layer (config.local.json) as it exists on disk, accepting only an allow-listed set of operational keys (provider enablement, priority, rate limits, timeouts and retries; response shape; the update check) and rejecting transport, credential, safety, and resource-bound keys — edit the file directly for those. It validates and activates the merged result before writing, backs up the exact bytes read, and rolls the layer back if activation fails; a `null` value removes that key from the layer. `migrate` true backs up and applies registered user-layer migrations before reloading. The call re-reads the startup configuration source and reports any user-layer schema drift. If the new configuration is invalid, the previous configuration stays active and an error is returned. Returns an [OK] or [ERROR] JSON envelope.

migrate.description: Back up and apply registered user-configuration-layer migrations before reloading (default false)

patch.description: Partial configuration merged into the user layer (config.local.json) as it exists on disk before reloading; only operational keys are accepted (provider enablement/priority/rate limits/timeouts/retries, response shape, update check), `null` removes a key, and the exact bytes read are backed up

name: infobroker_reload_config
title: Reload Configuration
